text:
maria: Heads-up — started seeing ~12% P99 latency regression on L4/T4 for short-chat workload after yesterday's kernel-selector tweak. A100/H100 unchanged. KV-cache hits look fine but tail spikes with batch=1. Posting profiles and kernel picks.

perf-bot: perf link: https://perf.internal/runs/2305xyz (profiling summary attached) — shows dispatcher CPU spin and a few expensive kernel launches on L4.

kai: can you paste the kernel pick log for a failing request?

maria: pasted snippet below (seq=16, batch=1, kv-warm=true):
```
[2023-05-01 12:01:23] kernel_selector: picked matmul_v2_small_tile on device l4 (score=0.72)
[2023-05-01 12:01:23] kernel_selector: picked kv_lookup_linear on device l4 (score=0.65)
[2023-05-01 12:01:23] runtime: dispatcher overhead 0.82ms
[2023-05-01 12:01:23] exec: matmul_v2_small_tile time 1.92ms
```

sam: hmm. heuristic seems to favor "small_tile" variants for the Turing/GraceLite class because of register pressure predictions. On L4 that pick increases kernel-switching frequency when KV cache is hot => more dispatcher overhead.

elena: I ran the microbench to reproduce locally:
```
./bench --model=gpt2-xl --seq=16 --batch=1 --kv-warm=true --device=l4 --kernel-log=1
```
output (trim):
```
[bench] total tokens 4096, avg latency 9.1ms, p99 72.3ms
[kernel] matmul_v2_small_tile 1.9ms
[kernel] kv_lookup_linear 0.6ms
[dispatch] context switch overhead 0.85ms
[notes] severe tail when kv cache hits occur concurrently with small-tile kernels
```

kai: try forcing the L4 pick to the large_tile matmul (same variant A100 uses) and re-run. If p99 drops, we can bias the autotuner for the L4/T4 family for short sequences.

maria: quick A/B: forced preset `prefer_large_tile` on l4 -> p99 dropped from 72.3ms to 62.1ms, avg latency up ~5% for long seqs but our short-chat SLO improved. L2 miss rate went down in perf counters.

sam: so basic plan: make kernel scoring aware of KV-cache "hot" state + batch==1 + seq<32 for L4/T4/A10. That should prefer larger tiles to reduce dispatcher thrash.

kai: I'll draft a small change: add term to kernel_score: +0.2 if (kv_cache_hot && batch_size==1 && seq_len<32 && device_family in [l4,t4,a10]) and a runtime flag `runtime.kernel_bias.crossdevice_kv_hotstart` to gate it. Also add telemetry tag `kernel_bias=kv_hotstart` so we can roll back.

elena: sgtm. please add a bench test that runs the short-chat harness with kv warm and asserts p99 improves by at least 8% on L4 emulation. Also include an opt-out config for Dedicated customers.

maria: filing follow-up ticket infra-3421 and will attach logs. @perf-bot can you schedule a 24h smoke run on the L4 pool with the new bias enabled (canary first)? :crossed_fingers:

perf-bot: Scheduled smoke: infra-3421 • 24h • l4-pool • canary=true • notif @maria @kai @elena

kai: picking this up now. I'll open PR with the score delta + runtime flag + a minimal benchmark. cc @sam for review. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks — after PR lands we'll run the 24h smoke and check metrics: p99, avg, L2 miss, and dispatcher CPU. If stable, we'll add the bias to the L4/T4 presets and ship a release.

(attachments: perf flame snippets, kernel-pick logs, bench outputs)
